summary: Verified the logout race-condition fix from iter-47. The 'Maximum update depth exceeded' burst during the logout -> /login transition is GONE (0 occurrences captured with a live console listener across all tested flows). Dashboard's nav-logout now calls nav('/login', {replace: true}) BEFORE awaiting logout(), so ProtectedRoute's Navigate and the manual nav no longer fight during the AnimatePresence exit. All specified regression items pass: session cleared after logout (/api/auth/me -> 401, protected routes redirect to /login), re-login lands on /dashboard with 4 tenants, no update-depth errors during dashboard -> app -> dashboard -> leads -> deploy navigation, notification bell opens, Leads inbox renders with New/Reviewed/Archived/All tabs. AuthContext.logout resilience confirmed: blocking POST /api/auth/logout still logs the user out locally (redirects to /login), and the new console.warn ('Logout request failed, clearing the session locally Network Error') was emitted instead of silent swallow.
critical_code_review_comments: Dashboard.jsx is 376 lines and mixes header, notif dropdown, filter bar, create-project dialog, ZIP/URL import polling, grid/list rendering — consider splitting into <DashboardHeader/>, <NewProjectDialog/>, <AppGrid/>, <AppList/> for maintainability (>700-line threshold not yet reached but complexity is high).

The route.abort() logout-resilience test shows the local session is cleared even though the server cookie remains valid; if the user opens a second tab it can still hit protected endpoints. Consider best-effort client-side cookie clear (document.cookie = 'session=; Max-Age=0') in the catch block so a network-failed logout is not deceptively 'logged out' locally while server-side session persists.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iter-47 design_issue #1 (Max update depth burst on logout) is verified resolved in iter-48. Fix pattern: navigate first with replace, THEN await async cleanup — good template for any future logout/session-clear flows. Leads page tabs are named New/Reviewed/Archived/All (not Real/Test/Archived as request wording suggested; that Real/Test/Archived naming likely applies to per-app Inbox, not the /leads master inbox).
rca of the issue: Not applicable — no bug reproduced; fix verified working.
